en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a grand, historic brick building with a prominent domed tower and arched windows. The text printed on the image reads 'Sundsvall. Brandstationen.' indicating it is the fire station in Sundsvall, Sweden. The reverse of the postcard features 'BREFKORT', 'CARTE POSTALE.' and 'POSTCARD' in red, indicating it is meant for international use, with dividing lines for address details. It also mentions 'Antikvariat-Bokhandeln, Sundsvall.'
